excerpt.zh: 塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。
excerpt.en: The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find the strength to thwart her mad ambition.
